SELECT
-- 用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT a.principal_name) AS total_user_count,
-- 截止昨天用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.create_time < CURDATE() THEN a.principal_name END) AS yesterday_total_user_count,
-- 截止上周用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.create_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN a.principal_name END) AS last_week_total_user_count,
-- 当前活跃用户 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.access_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN a.principal_name END) AS total_active_user_count,
-- 活跃会话数 COUNT(CASE WHEN a.refresh_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN 1 END) AS total_active_session_count,
-- 累计授权次数 COUNT(*) AS total_history_authorization_count,
COUNT(CASE WHEN a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS last_week_total_authorization_count
FROM oauth2_authorization a

SELECT ds.stat_date AS stat_date,
-- 累计用户总数：截至 stat_date 当天结束时 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN a.principal_name END), 0) AS total_user_count,
-- 当前活跃用户：在 stat_date 当天内，Access Token 处于有效期 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.access_token_expires_at > ds.stat_date AND a.access_token_issued_at < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN a.principal_name END), 0) AS total_active_user_count,
-- 活跃会话数：在 stat_date 当天内，Refresh Token 处于有效期 COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.refresh_token_expires_at > ds.stat_date AND a.refresh_token_issued_at < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END), 0) AS total_active_session_count,
-- 累计授权次数：截至 stat_date 当天结束时 COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END), 0) AS total_history_authorization_count
FROM dim_date ds LEFT JOIN oauth2_authorization a ON AND a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
-- 确定起始日期 (默认 CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY)
ds.stat_date >= #{startDate}
ds.stat_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY
-- 确定截止日期 (默认 CURDATE()) AND
ds.stat_date <= #{endDate}
ds.stat_date <= CURDATE()
GROUP BY ds.stat_date ORDER BY ds.stat_date ASC

SELECT d.stat_date AS letter, COUNT(a.id) AS frequency FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN oauth2_authorization a ON a.create_time >= d.stat_date AND a.create_time < DATE_ADD(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND WHERE AND d.stat_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY letter ASC

SELECT d.stat_date AS letter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.principal_name) AS frequency FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN oauth2_authorization a ON a.access_token_issued_at >= d.stat_date AND a.access_token_issued_at < DATE_ADD(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND WHERE GROUP BY d.stat_date ORDER BY letter ASC

SELECT c.application_name AS applicationName, CASE a.authorization_grant_type WHEN 'authorization_code' THEN '授权码模式' WHEN 'client_credentials' THEN '客户端模式' WHEN 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code' THEN '设备码模式' ELSE a.authorization_grant_type END AS grantType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM oauth2_authorization a LEFT JOIN oauth2_client_application c ON a.registered_client_id = c.registered_client_id WHERE a.authorization_grant_type IN ( 'authorization_code', 'client_credentials', 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code' ) AND a.create_time >= #{startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{endTime} AND GROUP BY c.application_name, a.authorization_grant_type
